conflicts_and_limits: Infrastructure-as-code does not eliminate backups of nonconfiguration state, secrets or artifacts despite source wording.
Advice to delay security tools must not override required controls or permit untrusted production workload during insecure tuning.
Source multiple-cluster, node-cost and production-custom-image assertions need workload-specific validation.
Supported installation paths, runner version windows, supported operating systems and spot limitations are pinned source assertions, not verified-current rollout rules.
DinD privileged sidecars and Kubernetes mode pod/secret authority require separate risk approval.
Cluster-level trust boundary is preserved; namespace or pod existence alone is not isolation evidence.
